urlencoded.label: repeated name keeps every value in order
brackets are part of the name
names keep the order of their first occurrence
plus is a space and percent sequences are bytes
a percent without two hexadecimal digits stays
a part without an equals sign has an empty value
the first equals sign separates the name
an empty name is a name
raw UTF-8 bytes are read as they are
a value that is not UTF-8 fails
a name that is not UTF-8 fails
a bracketed name that is not UTF-8 fails
a leading U+FEFF of a value is a character of the value

multipart.label: text fields in order with repeated and bracketed names
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="roles[]"

admin
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="title"

í ê¸
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="roles[]"

editor

multipart.label: a file field is not a form value
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="a"

1
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="a.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

file body
--XyZ--

multipart.label: a value keeps its line breaks and percent signs
a value that is not UTF-8 fails
files under one name keep their order
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="docs"; filename="a.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

A
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="title"

x
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="docs"; filename="b.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

B
--XyZ--

multipart.label: a file without a content type has an empty one
a part without a name is neither a value nor a file
a file with an empty filename is still a file
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename=""
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

E
--XyZ--

multipart.label: a quoted boundary of no character is the text with its quotes
a tab before the semicolon of the type is a blank
a no break space before a parameter separates nothing
header names and form data are read without case
a disposition of another type is neither a value nor a file
a lone carriage return does not end a header line
a lone line feed does not end a header line
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="n.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

N
--XyZ--

multipart.label: a content type loses its spaces and tabs around it
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="t.txt"
Content-Type: 	 text/plain 	

T
--XyZ--

multipart.label: a content type that ends with a no break space is not utf 8
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="t.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain 

T
--XyZ--

multipart.label: a filename that is not utf 8 fails the text fields too
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="a"

1
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="ÿ.txt"

F
--XyZ--

multipart.label: a token filename keeps its quote
a quoted filename keeps its backslashes
a quoted filename ends at its next quote
a part header of 8192 bytes is read
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="p.txt"
X-Pad: 

H
--XyZ--

multipart.label: a part header of 8193 bytes fails the body
multipart.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="p.txt"
X-Pad: 

H
--XyZ--

multipart.label: a part without an empty line and longer than 8192 bytes fails the body
an urlencoded type with a tab before its end is urlencoded
an urlencoded type followed by a line feed is another type
an urlencoded type with a parameter and another case is urlencoded
a body of another type has no values
a body without a type has no values
a multipart type without a boundary has no values
an absent name has no values and a decimal name is a name
